battleTraits.name: Immortal Elite
battleTraits.effect: Immortal Elite (Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round): You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number after the target's Relentless Discipline keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battleTraits.name: Impassive Retreat
battleTraits.effect: Impassive Retreat (Your Movement Phase): Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Ruthless Extermination
battleTraits.effect: Ruthless Extermination (Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for a unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase): Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that Shoot ability.

battleTraits.name: Pitiless Assault
battleTraits.effect: Pitiless Assault (Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase.): Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that Fight ability.

battleTraits.name: Remorseless March
battleTraits.effect: Remorseless March (Your Movement Phase): Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use run abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Inviolate Legions
battleTraits.effect: Inviolate Legions (Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability.): Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. That unit has Ward (5+) against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that Attack ability.

artefacts.name: Banner of Old Ossia
artefacts.effect:
Banner of Old Ossia: Reaction: You declared the 'Rally' command for a visible Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:
• For each rally point spent, Heal (1) another visible friendly non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
• You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

artefacts.name: Scarabaean Cloak
artefacts.effect: Scarabaean Cloak: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

artefacts.name: Soulweb Gem
artefacts.effect: Soulweb Gem: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn. Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

artefacts.name: Shard of the Necris
artefacts.effect: Shard of the Necris: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

artefacts.name: Blade of the Nadir
artefacts.effect: Blade of the Nadir: Deployment Phase Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the Fight ability has been resolved.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Gnosis
artefacts.effect: Amulet of Gnosis: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units by Retreat abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Manufactured Mind
heroicTraits.effect: Manufactured Mind: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round When picking a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Hero to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Hero that has been destroyed.

heroicTraits.name: Immaculate Defender
heroicTraits.effect: Immaculate Defender: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Infantry unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Imperious Will
heroicTraits.effect: Imperious Will: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit. Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-Hero unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Fight ability.

battleFormations.name: Border Guards
battleFormations.effect: Grim Sentinels: Melee weapons used by friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

battleFormations.name: The Inevitable Empire
battleFormations.effect: Silent Empire: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick an enemy unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

battleFormations.name: Ruthless Legion
battleFormations.effect: Nadirite Wedge: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit that charged this turn to use this ability. Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

battleFormations.name: Remorseless Conquerors
battleFormations.effect: Remorseless Conquerors: Reaction: You declared a Run ability for a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit. If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

battleFormations.name: Tithe Guards
battleFormations.effect:
Plentiful Bone: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Unique Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-Fly Ossiarch Bonereapers units wholly within 12" of that Wizard to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (X) the target where X is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.

battleFormations.name: Hekatos Drillmasters
battleFormations.effect:
Disciplined Hekatoi: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Fly Ossiarch Bonereapers Infantry unit to be the target. Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.
• The target has Ward (5+).
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks.
• The target's melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).
